extracted.name: Buffalo Sauce
extracted.description: Skip the store-bought buffalo sauce, and learn how to make your own instead! This homemade buffalo sauce is spicy, tangy, and SO easy to make. Find our favorite ways to use it in the post above.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup cayenne pepper hot sauce (such as Frank’s RedHot )
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, stir together the hot sauce, melted butter, honey, garlic powder, and paprika. Season to taste.
